text: No tree-cover loss occurred on this asset after 2020. The latest data from Hansen Global Forest Change (2025) and the JRC 2020 reference confirm no loss events meeting the minimum 0.5-ha threshold. The asset retained 11.55% forest cover in 2020 (JRC), and the annual series (2001–2025) shows no subsequent losses. The full area is covered by valid data (100% fraction), with no gaps or inconsistencies.
